signals.name: $230B+ Market
signals.description: The global content licensing and distribution market. The majority of this value flows through opaque, relationship-dependent channels. Vaizen makes it structural and searchable.

signals.name: Streaming Fragmentation
signals.description: Dozens of new platforms launched globally since 2020, each competing for indie content. More buyers, same broken discovery infrastructure. The demand has never been greater.

signals.name: No Neutral Platform
signals.description: Cinando and TVSL are dated and closed-network. There is no Bloomberg Terminal for film rights. That is the gap Vaizen fills — and it is already built.

benefits.title: Direct Access, Global Reach
benefits.description: Co-production deals, international exposure, sale of rights. Reach buyers in 50+ countries without a sales agent or market badge.

benefits.title: Structured Discovery
benefits.description: Organise your outreach strategy — not in a messy email inbox anymore. Buyers filter by genre, territory, festival pedigree, cast, director, and release window.

benefits.title: Avails Engine
benefits.description: Structure your avails. Multi-territory licensing availability declared upfront. Buyers know what's available before the first conversation — by window, by territory.

benefits.title: Verified Identities
benefits.description: Proper identity checks guaranteed. Work only with verified professionals with proper track record. Screeners reach verified acquisition professionals, not anonymous inboxes.

benefits.title: Always On
benefits.description: The marketplace that never sleeps. Unlike Cannes or AFM, deals can start at 2am on a Tuesday — from anywhere in the world.
